Original User Story: As a passenger, I want the AV to detect hazards in real-time using AI sensors, so that my safety is ensured.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a passenger, I want the autonomous vehicle (AV) to utilize AI sensors for real-time hazard detection so that my safety is guaranteed during travel.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The AV must identify and respond to at least 95% of potential hazards within a 50-meter radius in real-time.
- The system should provide alerts to passengers within 2 seconds of detecting a hazard.

Test Outline:
- Conduct tests to measure the percentage of hazards detected by the AV within the specified radius.
- Time the response from hazard detection to alert notification to ensure it meets the 2-second requirement.
- Analyze the data from the AI sensors to confirm the false positive rate remains below 5%.
